nodes.title: IMAGE CAPTION
widgets_values: A woman is standing in a room filled with debris. She is wearing a black leather bra top. She has long dark brown hair that is pulled back and cascades over her shoulders. Her eyes are a piercing blue and her lips are a darker red. Her hands are covered with black leather gloves. The walls of the room are made up of wooden planks and beams. Part of a white light can be seen shining through the cracks on the walls.

nodes.title: IMAGE CAPTION
widgets_values: A close-up portrait of a man's face and upper torso. The man's upper torso is visible, and he is wearing a maroon sleeveless shirt. His head is turned to the right, and his eyes are squinted. His hair is a dark brown, slicked back, and cascades over his shoulders. His eyebrows are a light brown, and there is a faint white line running down the middle of his face. His mouth is slightly open, with a slight smile on its lips. The wall behind the man is a light gray, and the wall behind him is a darker gray.
